author: IJustLostTheGame
body:
Hello everybody, this is my first map.
Name: TinyIsland
Creators: Da_Wiz_Fiz and Random_Guy

This map is intended for the mini walls rotation and even has a mini parkour to entertain the spectators!

This map was mainly made by me with YML help from Random_Guy, he also did most of the MCediting.

I hope this map is fitting for the mini walls rotation and any feedback would be appreciated.

Thanks! ^_^

Map and YML: here

replies.author: Lakitue
replies.body:
I actually like it. But you can probably improve some things!
- Remove the parkour. It will just come with death and be a gameplay ruiner!
- Make the middle lanes more detailed! At the moment they look a bit too simple.
- Instead of just having random wood peices that doesn't look too nice, use the command //replace 17:1 17:12
  it will basically make the woodblock just look better when it comes to building houses.
